programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Cuando un altamente clasificado vehículo robotizado llamado Otto causa la muerte de una teniente de la Marina, Gibbs y el equipo analizan si se trata de un suicidio o un homicidio.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Culpable por asociación
programme.desc: Cuando un testigo clave en el caso de Danny es asesinado justo antes de testificar, Erin enfurece a Danny al pedirle ayuda a Anthony (Steve Schrippa) para encontrar al asesino.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Negocios personales
programme.desc: Después de que Emily Harrison (Danielle Savre) le dice a Danny y Baez que teme que su ex novio abusivo vuelva a comportarse de la misma manera con su nueva novia, Emily se convierte en la principal sospechosa cuando él es asesinado.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Confesiones
programme.desc: Frank se queda con poca información para encontrar a un niño desaparecido cuando un sacerdote conflictuado que podría ayudar se niega a romper el sello de confesión.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Pérdida irreparable
programme.desc: Cuando el hijo de Frank, el crítico más abierto de la comunidad afroamericana, el Reverendo Darnell Potter (Ato Essandoh), es asesinado, Potter debe dejar de lado su relación controvertida con la familia Reagan para obtener justicia para su hijo.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: La UAC se dirige a Wichita en busca de un sospechoso que secuestra niños mientras sus padres duermen. Además, Morgan está intentando averiguar quién fue el responsable del ataque.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Cuando un sujeto ataca a la UAC, el equipo entra en acción para averiguar quién es el responsable.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Cuando la ex miembro del equipo de la UAC y actual agente de la Interpol, Emily Prentiss localiza a un asesino en serie internacional, pide la ayuda de sus amigos de la UAC.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: La UAC está buscando a un sospechoso que está desfigurando víctimas a propósito. Además, Rossi tiene un encuentro incómodo con su exesposa, Hayden Montgomery, quien mantuvo a su hija, Joy, en secreto durante casi 30 años.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Cuando un altamente clasificado vehículo robotizado llamado Otto causa la muerte de una teniente de la Marina, Gibbs y el equipo analizan si se trata de un suicidio o un homicidio.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs y su equipo se dirigen velozmente a una escena del crimen donde un oficial de inteligencia de alto nivel fue asesinado, descubriendo que el crimen sucedió tres días antes y fue "investigado" por autoridades locales.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Luego de la pérdida de 10 kilogrmos de armas químicas altamente tóxicas, Gibbs y su equipo luchan por localizarlas. El equipo de NCIS se horroriza cuando descubren que las armas químicas están en posesión de un buscado terrorista llamado Mamoun Sharif.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Luego de capturar a un vendedor de armas internacional, el equipo de NCIS descubre que un sistema de armamento altamente clasificado de la Marina está a punto de ser vendido a otro importante contrabandista llamado "La Grenouille" (Armand Assante).

programme.desc: 'S13/E39'. Kenners kyk na die jongste ontwikkelinge in die rugby-wreld. Ateljeegaste neem ook deel aan besprekings en beantwoord kykers se inbelvrae.

programme.title: Schuster
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Die legendariese Suid-Afrikaanse grapmaker Leon Schuster het deurlopende rugpyn na verskeie rugoperasies en bring die meeste van sy tyd in sy huis deur. Hy besluit om vir die eerste keer sy storie te vertel.

programme.title: Met 'n Huppel In Die Stap
programme.desc: 'S15/E18'. Die klein, bergagtige dorpie Haenertsburg word besoek waar verskeie inwoners, asook nuwe 'inkomers', hul stories vertel.

programme.title: Die Toring
programme.desc: 'S1/E9'. Jessica betrap vir Stella by Theo. Cazz se slinkse plan om op twee plekke gelyk te wees veroorsaak moeilikheid. Die span wend 'n laaste poging aan om Esti oor te wen.

programme.title: Die Toring
programme.desc: 'S1/E10'. Theo staar toenemende druk in sy verhouding in die gesig, terwyl Cazz 'n opregte ultimatum trotseer. Soos lewens bots, bereik die risiko's 'n hoogtepunt, sal hulle staande bly of val?

programme.title: Suidooster
programme.desc: 'S12/E152'. Mymoena spoor die meisie op wat die verf op Elzette en hulle ondersoeker gegooi het, terwyl Mike sukkel om sy ooreenkoms met Derek te finaliseer. Gary stel 'n ultimatum aan Claire.

programme.title: Skemergrond
programme.desc: 'S3/E72'. Sonja besef wat Rynard se plan is. Sy stel hom voor 'n ultimatum. Die Louws is op hete kole oor Christine en Rynard se troudag.

programme.title: Klaskamer 10
programme.desc: 'S10/E100'. Werner behandel graad 12 fisiese wetenskappe konsepte.

programme.title: Waar Daar 'n Wil Is

programme.title: Lottoland Help 'n Dorp

programme.title: Die Kantoor
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Die Touchy Game'. 'n Onskuldige touch-rugby wedstryd tydens middagete gee aanleiding tot Flip se ongewilde oortuigings oor vroue. Joubert kry Tjaart om al sy eks-vriendinne te bel om uit te vind of hulle swanger is.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: A New Era
programme.desc: The sequel to the film adaptation of the renowned English TV series. The Crawleys go to the South of France to visit a villa that the Dowager Countess unexpectedly inherits.

programme.title: Didi
programme.desc: Director Sean Wang gives us a candid look at being a teenager. Follow 13-year-old Chris Wang as he navigates his identity, first love, friendships, and family life during the summer of 2008.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: In this psychological horror with dark humour, singer Brandy Norwood finds herself facing a mother-in-law from hell when a pregnant couple takes in the husband's stepmother.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Adrien Brody delivers an Oscar-winning performance in this epic period drama. A visionary architect escapes postwar Europe for America, meeting a wealthy client who changes his life.

programme.title: Kingdoms Of Fire, Ice & Fairytales
programme.desc: Get up close and personal with the ice-covered landmass of Antarctica, the magical Black Forest of Germany, and the iconic Yellowstone of the USA, get up close and personal to these three world wonders.

programme.title: Girl You Know It's True
programme.desc: This is a fascinating music biopic about the music duo Milli Vanilli, who rose to fame in the late '80s and early '90s only to come crashing down after their secret is exposed.

programme.title: Skemerson
programme.desc: A young man battling mental illness decides to kill himself by jumping off the Bloukrans Bridge. On the bridge, he meets someone who sets his life on a completely different path.

programme.title: One Life
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins leads this true story of bravery. A London broker helps save hundreds of predominantly Jewish children from the Nazis just before the start of WWII.

programme.title: Infinite
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg and Chiwetel Ejiofor drive this book-inspired sci-fi action adaptation about a man who learns he's been reincarnated many times and holds the key to saving the world.

programme.title: Paws Of Fury: The Legend Of Hank
programme.desc: A starry voice cast drives this animated film. A down-on-his-luck dog finds himself in a town full of cats who need a hero to help save their village from a ruthless villain.

programme.title: Abominable
programme.desc: When mischievous friends Yi, Jin, and Peng discover a young Yeti on their roof, they name him Everest and embark on a thrilling adventure to reunite the magical creature with his family.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out Of...
programme.desc: The Spongebob Movie: Sponge Out Of Water. A great SpongeBob film. SpongeBob and his enemy team up to retrieve the stolen, Krabby Patty formula.

programme.title: A Thousand And One
programme.desc: Entertainer Teyana Taylor gives her all to this gritty, heartbreaking drama about an ex-con mother struggling to raise her son after abducting him from the foster care system.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale
programme.desc: A poignant, charming and funny send-off to the Crawley family and their staff. As they enter the 1930s, they face the threat of social disgrace due to a scandal and financial crisis.

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: Jackie Chan turns on the charm in this action film. A chauffeur is thrust into the world of international espionage when he puts on a suit that gives him extraordinary powers.

programme.title: Sting
programme.desc: A horror of epic proportions. A rebellious 12-year-old secretly keeps a spider as a pet, but the creature soon grows into a massive monster.

programme.title: Laroy, Texas
programme.desc: A riveting thriller riddled with dark humour. Ray learns his wife is having an affair and plans to kill himself. But his plans change when he's mistaken for a low-rent hitman.

programme.title: Don't Look Deeper
programme.desc: Don Cheadle and Emily Mortimer star in this film. A high schooler learns a dark secret about herself. Instead of dreaming about graduating, she's suddenly running for her life.

programme.title: The Wish Of Fairy Fish
programme.desc: An adventure-filled fairy tale fantasy. If you go fishing, be prepared to draw the fish of your dreams, the magical Pike, which can grant any three wishes.

programme.title: Kingdoms Of Fire, Ice & Fairytales
programme.desc: Get up close and personal with the ice-covered landmass of Antarctica, the magical Black Forest of Germany, and the iconic Yellowstone of the USA, get up close and personal to these three world wonders.

programme.title: Zero To Zero
programme.desc: A moving South African film about Covid-19. Filmed over a year, this unequalled footage from ICU and beyond tells a story of despair, hope and the strength of the human spirit.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Excellent performances and great music turn this movie into a smash hit. A new recruit helps transform an all-girl singing group's sound, leading them to take on a boy band.

programme.title: Dog
programme.desc: Channing Tatum drives this heartfelt drama. A former Army Ranger and a military dog are paired against their will on the road trip to a fellow soldier's funeral.

programme.title: Richard The Stork 2
programme.desc: Richard, the daring sparrow who was adopted by a stork family, is back for another adventure. He embarks on a solo journey when he realises he won't be his flock's leader.

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: A superpowered animation. A supervillain finally defeats his arch-rival, Metro Man. He soon becomes bored and creates a new hero for the town.

programme.title: The Bad Guys
programme.desc: Sam Rockwell lends his voice to this thrilling heist animation. Several reformed yet misunderstood criminal animals attempt to become good, with disastrous results.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg directs this sequel to the groundbreaking Oscar-winning film. A research team is taken to Island B to study the dinosaurs, but a great threat is approaching.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A charming dinner turns into a nightmare in this pulse-pounding thriller. While on a date, a widowed mother receives terrifying anonymous messages to kill her date or lose her son.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: This chilling reimagining of a classic tale got four Oscar nominations. When a terrifying vampire becomes infatuated with a young woman, a series of inexplicable horrors are unleashed.

programme.title: Saw X
programme.desc: The tenth film in the horror franchise, with Tobin Bell returning. Set between the events of SAW I and II, John Kramer plots his twisted revenge on the doctors who conned him.
